whatsappMessage:
Hi Gold's Gym Rajendra Nagar Team,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.0★ reviews across 790+ members in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for fast membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gold-s-rajendra-nagar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Gold's Gym Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Gold's Gym, Rajendra Nagar) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and your core fitness programs in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact trainers, actual gym photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
